sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内血液已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.

sentences.en: Shortly after 3 on the afternoon of Friday, December 30, 1921, Melbourne cab driver Joseph Graham was strolling up Little Collins Street on his way to the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 1921年12月30日，星期五，下午3点刚过，墨尔本出租车司机约瑟夫·格雷厄姆（Joseph Graham）正沿着小柯林斯街（Little Collins Street）散步，准备去杂货店。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, a piercing, high-pitched scream rang out.
sentences.zh: 突然，一声尖锐刺耳的尖叫声响起。

sentences.en: The area was notoriously rowdy, but in the hundreds of times that Joseph had been there, he'd never heard such a heart-rending scream.
sentences.zh: 该地区向来以混乱著称，但约瑟夫在那里待过数百次，从未听过如此撕心裂肺的尖叫声。

sentences.en: He described it as sounding like a little girl terrified at what was occurring or what was about to occur.
sentences.zh: 他形容那听起来像是一个小女孩对正在发生或即将发生的事情感到极度恐惧。

sentences.en: Joseph estimated that the girl was between the ages of 10 and 15.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫估计那个女孩的年龄在10到15岁之间。

sentences.en: It sounded as if she was being dragged somewhere close by.
sentences.zh: 听起来她似乎正被拖往附近某个地方。

sentences.en: Five or six more screams followed, each more terrifying than the last, as the girl was slowly drained of energy.
sentences.zh: 随后又传来了五六声尖叫，一声比一声惊恐，仿佛那个女孩的力气正在一点点耗尽。

sentences.en: Further down the street, another man also heard the screaMs.
sentences.zh: 在街道更远处，另一名男子也听到了尖叫声。

sentences.en: He and Joseph glanced around, trying to identify where exactly the noise was coming from.
sentences.zh: 他和约瑟夫四处张望，试图确定声音究竟是从哪里传来的。

sentences.en: While they couldn't narrow down an exact spot, they seemed to be coming from the direction of Gun Alley.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们无法锁定确切位置，但声音似乎来自枪巷（Gun Alley）方向。

sentences.en: When Joseph Graham heard about Alma Tershki's murder a little over a week later,
sentences.zh: 一周多后，当约瑟夫·格雷厄姆听说阿尔玛·特什基（Alma Tershki）遇害的消息时，

sentences.en: he went straight to the police to report the screams he'd heard on Little Collins Street on the afternoon of December 30.
sentences.zh: 他直接去警察局报告了他在12月30日下午在小柯林斯街听到的尖叫声。

sentences.en: The officers didn't seem interested.
sentences.zh: 警官们似乎并不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Plenty of people brought their children into the city and it wasn't unusual to hear them screeching for a litany of innocent reasons.
sentences.zh: 很多人带孩子进城，听到他们因为各种无辜的原因尖叫并不罕见。

sentences.en: Some local business owners brought their children to work with them, including a nearby barber, whose young daughter was known for her screeching.
sentences.zh: 一些当地店主会带孩子上班，包括附近的一位理发师，他的小女儿就以爱尖叫而闻名。

sentences.en: Despite these explanations, Joseph remained certain that what he'd heard wasn't just a child playfully acting up.
sentences.zh: 尽管有这些解释，约瑟夫依然确信他听到的绝不是孩子在玩闹。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, at a police station in the regional town of Ballarat, the other man who heard the screams also came forward.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在巴拉瑞特（Ballarat）地区城镇的一家警察局，另一位听到尖叫声的男子也站了出来。

sentences.en: Like Joseph, he reported that the screaming occurred sometime between around 3.05 and 3.25pm.
sentences.zh: 和约瑟夫一样，他报告说尖叫声发生在下午3点05分到3点25分之间。

sentences.en: But unlike Joseph, he didn't think there were multiple screams, just a single scream that echoed down the street.
sentences.zh: 但与约瑟夫不同的是，他认为并没有多次尖叫，只有一声尖叫在街上回荡。

sentences.en: He thought it was emanating from a derelict lodging house next to Gun Alley, but as he walked towards the distressing sound, it suddenly stopped.
sentences.zh: 他以为声音来自枪巷旁边的一间废弃旅馆，但当他走向那令人不安的声音时，声音突然停止了。

sentences.en: The man convinced himself it was just an unruly child being disciplined by an exasperated parent and carried on with his day.
sentences.zh: 那名男子说服自己这只是一个顽皮的孩子被恼火的父母管教，于是继续忙自己的事去了。

sentences.en: When he heard about Alma Tershki's murder, he thought about contacting the police, but he was unwell at the time and didn't want the publicity.
sentences.zh: 当他听说阿尔玛·特什基遇害的消息时，他想过联系警方，但他当时身体不适，不想引起公众关注。

sentences.en: He also assumed the other witness, Joseph Graham, would report it, thus negating his need to do so.
sentences.zh: 他也以为另一位目击者约瑟夫·格雷厄姆会去报告，从而省去了他去报案的必要。

sentences.en: When the days passed with no reports about the screams in the papers, he finally decided to come forward,
sentences.zh: 当几天过去，报纸上没有任何关于尖叫声的报道时，他终于决定站出来，

sentences.en: saying there was a stallholder in the eastern market who could corroborate his version of events.
sentences.zh: 称东区市场（Eastern Market）有一位摊主可以证实他的说法。

sentences.en: Ballarat police forwarded this information to the detectives fronting the Tershki case.
sentences.zh: 巴拉瑞特警方将此信息转交给了负责特什基案的侦探。

sentences.en: They now had two independent accounts of a girl screaming in fright around Little Collins Street between 3 and 3.30pm on Friday December 30.
sentences.zh: 他们现在有了两份独立的证词，都提到12月30日星期五下午3点到3点30分之间，小柯林斯街附近有一个女孩在惊恐地尖叫。

sentences.en: These reports aligned with the last confirmed sighting of Alma Tershki after she left the eastern arcade, on the very corner where the lodging house was located.
sentences.zh: 这些报告与阿尔玛·特什基离开东区拱廊（Eastern Arcade）后的最后一次确切目击记录相吻合，而那正是那间旅馆所在的街角。

sentences.en: This posed a major problem for investigators.
sentences.zh: 这对调查人员来说是一个重大问题。

sentences.en: They'd been working on the theory that Alma had been lured somewhere private to be assaulted before her body was dumped in Gun Alley later that night.
sentences.zh: 他们一直推测阿尔玛是被诱骗到某个私密地点遭到袭击，然后当晚尸体被抛弃在枪巷。

sentences.en: What's more, if the screams heard had indeed come from Alma, it vindicated their prime suspect, Colin Ross.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，如果听到的尖叫声确实来自阿尔玛，那就证明了他们的头号嫌疑人科林·罗斯（Colin Ross）是无辜的。

sentences.en: When Colin Ross was found guilty of the 12-year-old's murder, his family were left stunned.
sentences.zh: 当科林·罗斯被判谋杀这名12岁女孩罪名成立时，他的家人感到震惊。

sentences.en: From the outset of the investigation, they knew there was no way he could have done it.
sentences.zh: 从调查一开始，他们就知道他绝不可能做出这种事。

sentences.en: For starters, Colin's brother, Stanley Ross, worked alongside Colin at the Australian Wine Saloon.
sentences.zh: 首先，科林的兄弟斯坦利·罗斯（Stanley Ross）在澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙（Australian Wine Saloon）与科林一起工作。

sentences.en: At around 2pm on Friday December 30, 1921, Stanley was in his usual spot behind the bar when Colin arrived for work.
sentences.zh: 1921年12月30日星期五下午2点左右，斯坦利像往常一样在吧台后面，这时科林来上班了。

sentences.en: It was a relatively quiet afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天下午相对安静。

sentences.en: The brothers spent the entire afternoon serving and interacting with the few clientele.
sentences.zh: 兄弟俩整个下午都在为少数几位顾客服务并与他们交流。

sentences.en: At no point did Stanley see a young girl matching Alma Tershki's description in the saloon.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利从未在沙龙里见过符合阿尔玛·特什基特征的年轻女孩。

sentences.en: Colin sometimes brought women into the private room behind the bar, but they were never as young as Alma.
sentences.zh: 科林有时会带女性进入吧台后面的私人房间，但她们从来没有像阿尔玛那么年轻。

sentences.en: Former bartender Ivy Matthews and saloon customer Francis Upton had both served as star witnesses for the prosecution, implicating Colin in the young girl's murder.
sentences.zh: 前调酒师艾薇·马修斯（Ivy Matthews）和沙龙顾客弗朗西斯·厄普顿（Francis Upton）都曾作为控方明星证人出庭，指控科林谋杀了那个年轻女孩。

sentences.en: Both claimed they had been drinking at the Australian Wine Saloon Friday December 30, 1921, where they ordered drinks at the bar.
sentences.zh: 两人都声称他们于1921年12月30日星期五在澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙喝酒，并在吧台点了酒。

sentences.en: But Stanley had been behind the bar all afternoon, and at no point did he see either one of them.
sentences.zh: 但斯坦利整个下午都在吧台后面，他从未见过他们中的任何一个。

sentences.en: The only witness he did see was Olive Maddox.
sentences.zh: 他唯一见到的证人是奥利弗·马多克斯（Olive Maddox）。

sentences.en: Olive had testified to seeing an underage girl matching Alma's description drinking in the parlour and had confronted Colin about it.
sentences.zh: 奥利弗曾作证说看到一个符合阿尔玛特征的未成年女孩在客厅喝酒，并就此质问过科林。

sentences.en: Yet, according to Stanley, this never happened.
sentences.zh: 然而，据斯坦利所说，这从未发生过。

sentences.en: Olive did briefly greet Colin at the bar, but the pair didn't engage in any meaningful conversation, and she never mentioned the presence of a young girl.
sentences.zh: 奥利弗确实在吧台简短地向科林打过招呼，但两人并没有进行任何实质性的交谈，她也从未提到过有年轻女孩在场。

sentences.en: Stanley and Colin remained at the saloon together until closing time, at which point Colin went home for dinner while Stanley ate at a nearby restaurant.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利和科林一直待在沙龙直到打烊，随后科林回家吃晚饭，而斯坦利在附近的一家餐馆用餐。

sentences.en: At 7.30pm, Stanley returned to the saloon to use the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点30分，斯坦利回到沙龙使用洗手间。

sentences.en: No one else was in there.
sentences.zh: 里面没有其他人。

sentences.en: Colin had always maintained that he'd met his friend Gladys in the city before returning home at around midnight and going straight to bed.
sentences.zh: 科林一直坚称他在午夜左右回家并直接上床睡觉前，曾在城里见过他的朋友格拉迪斯（Gladys）。

sentences.en: His mother, Edie Ross, vouched for this.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲伊迪·罗斯（Edie Ross）为此作证。

sentences.en: She recalled that Colin had arrived home at around 7pm, ate dinner, and then went out again.
sentences.zh: 她记得科林大约在晚上7点到家，吃了晚饭，然后又出去了。

sentences.en: Edie was still up when Colin returned around midnight.
sentences.zh: 科林午夜左右回来时，伊迪还没睡。

sentences.en: He went straight to the bedroom he shared with another of his brothers, Ronald.
sentences.zh: 他直接回到了他和另一个兄弟罗纳德（Ronald）共用的卧室。

sentences.en: A military man who'd served overseas, Ronald was a light sleeper who woke at the slightest of noises.
sentences.zh: 罗纳德是一名曾在海外服役的军人，睡眠很浅，稍有动静就会醒来。

sentences.en: He stirred when Colin entered the room and was certain he couldn't have left during the night without waking him.
sentences.zh: 科林进屋时他被惊醒了，他确信科林不可能在夜里离开而不惊动他。

sentences.en: According to prosecution witness Sydney Harding,
sentences.zh: 据控方证人悉尼·哈丁（Sydney Harding）称，

sentences.en: Colin had confessed to killing Alma in the back room behind the bar before cleaning the scene.
sentences.zh: 科林曾承认在吧台后面的后室杀害了阿尔玛，并清理了现场。

sentences.en: Stanley Ross had returned to the Australian wine saloon on Saturday morning to prepare for the day's trade.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利·罗斯在周六早上回到澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙准备当天的营业。

sentences.en: He swept the floor and scrubbed surfaces.
sentences.zh: 他扫了地并擦洗了表面。

sentences.en: There was no indication that the saloon, or its back room, had been cleaned the previous night.
sentences.zh: 没有任何迹象表明沙龙或其后室在前一天晚上被清理过。

sentences.en: The Ross family testified at trial in support of Colin and corroborated his version of events.
sentences.zh: 罗斯一家在审判中出庭支持科林，并证实了他的说法。

sentences.en: Edie described Colin as a good son who was a bit rough around the edges, but certainly not a child killer.
sentences.zh: 伊迪形容科林是个好儿子，虽然有点粗鲁，但绝不是杀童凶手。

sentences.en: Another one of Colin's brothers named Thomas told the court that when the family heard news of Colin's arrest, they found it comical in its absurdity.
sentences.zh: 科林的另一个兄弟托马斯（Thomas）告诉法庭，当家人听到科林被捕的消息时，他们觉得这荒谬得可笑。

sentences.en: Thomas explained,
sentences.zh: 托马斯解释说，

sentences.en: I thought that my brother would have been the last man in the world to be detained.
sentences.zh: “我觉得我兄弟是世界上最不可能被拘留的人。”

sentences.en: To outsiders, the Ross family were just protecting one of their own.
sentences.zh: 在外人看来，罗斯一家只是在保护自己人。

sentences.en: No one seemed to consider the possibility that they were telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 似乎没有人考虑过他们说的是真话的可能性。

sentences.en: After Colin's conviction, his family gathered at their home to plot their next move.
sentences.zh: 科林被定罪后，他的家人聚集在家中策划下一步行动。

sentences.en: They agreed without hesitation to mortgage their house to fund an appeal.
sentences.zh: 他们毫不犹豫地同意抵押房产来筹集上诉资金。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, there was a knock at the front door.
sentences.zh: 突然，前门响起了敲门声。

sentences.en: Standing outside was a young woman who introduced herself as Florence Rudkin.
sentences.zh: 站在门外的是一位年轻女子，她自称是弗洛伦斯·鲁德金（Florence Rudkin）。

sentences.en: She was well aware of the infamous Tershki case.
sentences.zh: 她非常了解臭名昭著的特什基案。

sentences.en: The vicious frenzy it had stirred up in Melbourne had prevented Florence from coming forward sooner as she wanted no association with it.
sentences.zh: 该案在墨尔本引发的恶性狂热使弗洛伦斯无法早点站出来，因为她不想与此案有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: But with Colin being found guilty,
sentences.zh: 但随着科林被判有罪，

sentences.en: Florence put her personal feelings aside to reveal what she knew.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯抛开了个人感受，揭露了她所知道的情况。

sentences.en: At around five on the afternoon of Friday December 30, 1921,
sentences.zh: 1921年12月30日星期五下午五点左右，

sentences.en: Florence had stopped in at the Australian Wine Saloon.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯曾顺道去了澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙。

sentences.en: She visited occasionally as it was a quiet establishment where she could be left alone.
sentences.zh: 她偶尔会去那里，因为那是一个安静的场所，她可以独自待着。

sentences.en: Florence settled into a dark corner in the parlour.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯在客厅的一个阴暗角落坐了下来。

sentences.en: It was an uneventful visit until Olive Maddox dropped in.
sentences.zh: 那是一次平淡无奇的访问，直到奥利弗·马多克斯进来。

sentences.en: Boisterous and unsteady, Olive was clearly intoxicated.
sentences.zh: 奥利弗喧闹且站立不稳，显然喝醉了。

sentences.en: She stood at the parlour's entrance and examined the room before moving off.
sentences.zh: 她站在客厅入口处审视了一番房间，然后走开了。

sentences.en: Florence was still in the parlour when Olive reappeared an hour later, right before closing time.
sentences.zh: 一小时后，就在打烊前，当奥利弗再次出现时，弗洛伦斯还在客厅里。

sentences.en: When Florence went to leave, Colin Ross was still there.
sentences.zh: 当弗洛伦斯准备离开时，科林·罗斯还在那里。

sentences.en: She caught a glimpse of the private room behind the bar.
sentences.zh: 她瞥了一眼吧台后面的私人房间。

sentences.en: There was no one there.
sentences.zh: 里面没有人。

sentences.en: The reason Florence felt it was so important to come forward with this information was that she had flowing red hair.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯觉得站出来提供这些信息如此重要的原因是，她留着一头飘逸的红发。

sentences.en: At the time of her visit to the saloon, she'd been wearing a hat, just like Alma Tershki.
sentences.zh: 她去沙龙时戴着一顶帽子，就像阿尔玛·特什基一样。

sentences.en: Given that the parlour was dimly lit and Olive Maddox had been intoxicated,
sentences.zh: 考虑到客厅光线昏暗，而奥利弗·马多克斯又喝醉了，

sentences.en: Florence feared that Olive had mistaken her for Alma.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯担心奥利弗把她误认成了阿尔玛。

sentences.en: Stanley Ross had remembered Florence Rudkin as one of their few customers that day.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利·罗斯记得弗洛伦斯·鲁德金是那天为数不多的顾客之一。

sentences.en: He'd sought her out when his brother was initially detained, but he only knew her as Flory and was unable to track her down.
sentences.zh: 在他兄弟最初被拘留时，他曾寻找过她，但他只知道她叫弗洛里（Flory），无法追踪到她。

sentences.en: Florence Rudkin was told to take her story to a man named Thomas Brennan.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯·鲁德金被告知将她的故事告诉一个叫托马斯·布伦南（Thomas Brennan）的人。

sentences.en: An experienced and formidable criminal attorney,
sentences.zh: 作为一名经验丰富且令人敬畏的刑事律师，

sentences.en: Brennan was one part of Colin's two-man legal team.
sentences.zh: 布伦南是科林两人律师团队的一员。

sentences.en: Like the Rosses, Brennan was left speechless by Colin's conviction.
sentences.zh: 和罗斯一家一样，布伦南对科林的定罪感到目瞪口呆。

sentences.en: He'd never doubted the man was innocent, and after hearing the entirety of the prosecution's evidence in person,
sentences.zh: 他从未怀疑过这个人是无辜的，在亲自听取了控方的全部证据后，

sentences.en: he couldn't believe the jury had found him guilty beyond reasonable doubt.
sentences.zh: 他无法相信陪审团竟然在排除合理怀疑的情况下判他有罪。

sentences.en: In the defence's opinion, the prosecution's case was not only absolutely incoherent, but absolutely inconsistent.
sentences.zh: 在辩方看来，控方的案件不仅完全不连贯，而且完全前后矛盾。

sentences.en: After detailing all of its flaws and inconsistencies,
sentences.zh: 在详细说明了其所有缺陷和矛盾之后，

sentences.en: they were certain Colin was going to walk from court a free man.
sentences.zh: 他们确信科林会作为自由人走出法庭。

sentences.en: As far as the defence were concerned, the prosecution's star witnesses were a quintent of disreputables.
sentences.zh: 在辩方看来，控方的明星证人是一群声名狼藉之徒。

sentences.en: For starters, there was Francis Upton, the man who claimed to have visited the Australian wine saloon
sentences.zh: 首先是弗朗西斯·厄普顿，那个声称在12月30日午夜后访问澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙，

sentences.en: after midnight on December 30 to encounter Colin Ross with blood-stained hands.
sentences.zh: 并遇到双手沾满鲜血的科林·罗斯的人。

sentences.en: Francis had also implicated an unidentified woman, who he claimed to have heard in the saloon with Colin.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯还牵扯进了一名身份不明的女子，他声称在沙龙里听到了她和科林在一起。

sentences.en: Thomas Brennan was incredulous of Francis's testimony from the outset.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·布伦南从一开始就对弗朗西斯的证词表示怀疑。

sentences.en: In Brennan's words, Francis was a derelict, a drunkard, a wife-deserter, a notorious romancer, and convicted criminal.
sentences.zh: 用布伦南的话说，弗朗西斯是个流浪汉、酒鬼、抛妻弃子者、臭名昭著的骗子和罪犯。

sentences.en: His rap sheet included charges for larceny, drunkenness, and embezzlement.
sentences.zh: 他的犯罪记录包括盗窃、酗酒和贪污指控。

sentences.en: In court, Francis described himself as a bad character who'd skipped out on his wife and kids and spent all his earnings on alcohol.
sentences.zh: 在法庭上，弗朗西斯形容自己是个坏人，抛弃了妻子和孩子，把所有的收入都花在了酒精上。

sentences.en: Brennan hoped the jury would realise that testimony beginning with the witness regaining consciousness in a park after a bender necessitated a considerable degree of scepticism.
sentences.zh: 布伦南希望陪审团能意识到，如果证词的开头是证人在狂饮后在公园里恢复意识，那么这就需要相当程度的怀疑。

sentences.en: Francis even admitted during cross-examination that he usually got so drunk he didn't remember anything.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯甚至在交叉盘问中承认，他通常喝得太醉，什么都不记得了。

sentences.en: In fact, he was such a prolific alcoholic that he had no memories of ever visiting the Australian wine saloon except for on December 30.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他是一个如此多产的酒鬼，以至于除了12月30日那天，他对访问澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙没有任何记忆。

sentences.en: Francis said he'd learnt of Alma Tershki's murder on January 2, yet he only approached police to implicate Colin Ross after the £1,000 reward was offered.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯说他在1月2日得知了阿尔玛·特什基的谋杀案，但他直到悬赏1000英镑后才联系警方指控科林·罗斯。

sentences.en: Then there were the two jailbirds, Sidney Harding and Joseph Dunstan.
sentences.zh: 还有两个狱友，悉尼·哈丁（Sidney Harding）和约瑟夫·邓斯坦（Joseph Dunstan）。

sentences.en: Sidney testified that Colin had confessed to killing Alma while they were in the prison yard.
sentences.zh: 悉尼作证说，科林在监狱院子里时承认杀害了阿尔玛。

sentences.en: Joseph corroborated this, saying he overheard parts of the confession.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫证实了这一点，说他无意中听到了部分供词。

sentences.en: Thomas Brennan had explained to the jury why they should be wary of these claiMs.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·布伦南向陪审团解释了为什么他们应该对这些说法保持警惕。

sentences.en: Sidney and Joseph were convicted criminals with a history including assault, larceny, receiving stolen goods, and even perjury.
sentences.zh: 悉尼和约瑟夫是有前科的罪犯，有包括袭击、盗窃、收受赃物甚至伪证罪在内的犯罪记录。

sentences.en: Not only were they known to one another, they were on remand for a housebreaking they committed together.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅彼此认识，而且因为一起犯下的入室盗窃罪而被还押候审。

sentences.en: Sidney Harding had come forward to the police before the coronial inquest, but after the big reward was announced.
sentences.zh: 悉尼·哈丁在验尸官调查之前就向警方报案了，但那是在大额悬赏宣布之后。

sentences.en: After establishing himself as a star prosecution witness,
sentences.zh: 在确立了自己作为控方明星证人的地位后，

sentences.en: Sidney was permitted to leave the confines of jail and live in far cosier lodgings near the city.
sentences.zh: 悉尼被允许离开监狱的禁锢，住在离城市更舒适的住所里。

sentences.en: It was a fitting prize for a man other prisoners referred to as a dog due to his reputation as a snitch.
sentences.zh: 对于一个因告密名声在外而被其他囚犯称为“狗”的人来说，这是一个合适的奖赏。

sentences.en: Colin Ross knew of Sidney's dishonourable notoriety and in no way considered him a friend.
sentences.zh: 科林·罗斯知道悉尼不光彩的名声，绝不认为他是朋友。

sentences.en: Thomas Brennan assumed the jury would realise how comical the whole set-up was.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·布伦南认为陪审团会意识到整个安排是多么可笑。

sentences.en: Why would his client trust a criminal he barely knew who had a reputation for leaking information to police?
sentences.zh: 他的当事人为什么要信任一个他几乎不认识、且有向警方泄密名声的罪犯？

sentences.en: During one prison visit,
sentences.zh: 在一次监狱探视期间，

sentences.en: Colin's legal team had warned him, say nothing, they'll plant people in here to testify against you.
sentences.zh: 科林的法律团队曾警告他：什么都别说，他们会在这里安插人手来指证你。

sentences.en: It made no sense for him to then go and divulge everything about the murder to a random inmate.
sentences.zh: 他再去向一个随机的囚犯泄露关于谋杀案的一切，这根本说不通。

sentences.en: Joseph Dunstan came forward to police after the coronial inquest, but before the trial.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·邓斯坦在验尸官调查之后、审判之前向警方报案。

sentences.en: He admitted that he'd spoken to Sidney before making his statement.
sentences.zh: 他承认在发表声明前曾与悉尼交谈过。

sentences.en: Both men also revealed that they'd read the daily paper together, which featured detailed updates on the Tershke case.
sentences.zh: 两人还透露，他们曾一起阅读日报，报纸上刊登了特什基案的详细进展。

sentences.en: These stories included all the evidence,
sentences.zh: 这些故事包含了所有的证据，

sentences.en: Colin's version of events, and the allegations other witnesses had made against him.
sentences.zh: 科林的事件版本，以及其他证人对他提出的指控。

sentences.en: Another prisoner on remand with the two witnesses claimed that he'd overheard Sidney tell Joseph,
sentences.zh: 另一名与这两名证人一起候审的囚犯声称，他无意中听到西德尼对约瑟夫说，

sentences.en: I have told you about Ross, and I will fix you up after the trial.
sentences.zh: 我已经告诉过你关于罗斯的事了，审判结束后我会帮你摆平的。

sentences.en: Thomas Brennan knew better than most that assertions made by prison snitches should be considered with extreme caution.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·布伦南比大多数人都清楚，监狱线人所做的断言应该极其谨慎地对待。

sentences.en: Sidney and Joseph had proven themselves liars in the past, pleading innocent for crimes they were ultimately found guilty of.
sentences.zh: 西德尼和约瑟夫过去已证明自己是骗子，他们曾为自己最终被判有罪的罪行辩称无罪。

sentences.en: Criminals usually didn't help the police unless there was something in it for them.
sentences.zh: 罪犯通常不会帮助警方，除非这对他们有利可图。

sentences.en: The jury were told to consider the likelihood the pair were offered a deal to testify against Colin.
sentences.zh: 陪审团被告知要考虑这两人是否因出庭指证科林而获得了某种交易。

sentences.en: As for Ivy Matthews, the former bartender who claimed to have seen Alma Tershke drinking in the private room behind the bar of the Australian Wine Saloon,
sentences.zh: 至于艾薇·马修斯，那位前酒保声称曾看到阿尔玛·特什基在澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙酒吧后面的私人房间里喝酒，

sentences.en: the defence had some serious doubts about her story.
sentences.zh: 辩方对她的故事存有严重怀疑。

sentences.en: Ivy was first interviewed by detectives almost a week after Alma's body was discovered.
sentences.zh: 艾薇是在阿尔玛的尸体被发现近一周后首次接受侦探采访的。

sentences.en: At that time, Ivy said she hadn't seen Alma and knew nothing about what had happened to her.
sentences.zh: 当时，艾薇说她没有见过阿尔玛，也不知道她发生了什么事。

sentences.en: It was only weeks later that she came forward to police with her story implicating Colin Ross in the crime.
sentences.zh: 直到几周后，她才向警方提供故事，指控科林·罗斯犯下了这起罪行。

sentences.en: When asked why she hadn't revealed this pertinent information during her first interview,
sentences.zh: 当被问及为什么在第一次采访时没有透露这些相关信息时，

sentences.en: Ivy said as a former employee of Colin's, she felt a degree of loyalty to him.
sentences.zh: 艾薇说，作为科林的前员工，她对他有一种忠诚感。

sentences.en: Both Ivy Matthews and Olive Maddox claimed to have seen a girl matching Alma Tershke's description drinking at the saloon on the afternoon of December 30.
sentences.zh: 艾薇·马修斯和奥利夫·马多克斯都声称，12月30日下午在沙龙看到一个符合阿尔玛·特什基描述的女孩在喝酒。

sentences.en: Colin had allegedly confessed to giving Alma upwards of three glasses of wine prior to the attack.
sentences.zh: 据称，科林承认在袭击发生前给了阿尔玛三杯以上的葡萄酒。

sentences.en: However, Alma's stomach had been examined post-mortem for traces of alcohol, and none were found.
sentences.zh: 然而，阿尔玛的胃在死后经过了酒精痕迹检查，结果什么也没发现。

sentences.en: During Colin's trial, the defence pointed out that both Ivy and Olive had added more damning claims against Colin every time they were interviewed.
sentences.zh: 在科林的审判期间，辩方指出，艾薇和奥利夫每次接受采访时，都会增加更多对科林不利的指控。

sentences.en: Not only did they come forward after the £1,000 reward was on offer, they also revealed key information only when the same information had just been reported by the press.
sentences.zh: 她们不仅是在1000英镑的悬赏金出现后才站出来的，而且她们透露的关键信息也只是在媒体刚刚报道了同样的信息时才说出来的。

sentences.en: Ivy and Olive were long-time friends who admitted to having discussed the case on multiple occasions before and after Colin's arreSt.
sentences.zh: 艾薇和奥利夫是多年的朋友，她们承认在科林被捕前后曾多次讨论过此案。

sentences.en: As far as the defence were concerned, the two women had colluded to falsely accuse Colin in a bid to claim the reward money.
sentences.zh: 在辩方看来，这两名女子串通一气，为了骗取赏金而诬告科林。

sentences.en: While the women claimed that they were amicable with Colin, he said otherwise.
sentences.zh: 虽然这两名女子声称她们与科林关系友好，但他却不这么认为。

sentences.en: Olive and Colin had a temperamental history with one another and hadn't spoken for months.
sentences.zh: 奥利夫和科林之间有过一段情绪化的历史，已经几个月没说话了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Ivy had been aggressively demanding money from him that she felt was owed to her.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，艾薇一直咄咄逼人地向他索要她认为他欠她的钱。

sentences.en: She was also bitter about having lost her job at the saloon, with Colin asserting that Ivy would, quote,
sentences.zh: 她还因为在沙龙丢了工作而感到愤恨，科林断言艾薇会，引用的话说，

sentences.en: Do anything for spite to get even with him.
sentences.zh: 为了报复他，什么事都做得出来。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: As the defence pointed out, the only moments where the five key witnesses' stories aligned was when they were presenting information
sentences.zh: 正如辩方所指出的，五名关键证人的故事唯一吻合的时刻是他们陈述信息的时候，

sentences.en: that had been published in the papers.
sentences.zh: 而这些信息已经在报纸上发表过了。

sentences.en: The other mysteries of the case, such as how exactly Alma came to be in the saloon and how her body was disposed of, conflicted between accounts.
sentences.zh: 案件的其他谜团，例如阿尔玛究竟是如何进入沙龙的，以及她的尸体是如何处理的，在各方的陈述中都存在冲突。

sentences.en: Colin had allegedly told Ivy that Alma approached him and asked for a drink.
sentences.zh: 据称科林告诉艾薇，阿尔玛走近他并要了一杯酒。

sentences.en: In Sydney's version of events, it was Colin who coaxed the girl into his saloon.
sentences.zh: 在西德尼的事件版本中，是科林诱骗那个女孩进入他的沙龙的。

sentences.en: Ivy said she'd seen Alma in the room behind the bar at 3pm, while Olive said she saw Alma at 5pm in the parlour.
sentences.zh: 艾薇说她在下午3点看到阿尔玛在酒吧后面的房间里，而奥利夫说她在下午5点在客厅看到了阿尔玛。

sentences.en: In Ivy's version,
sentences.zh: 在艾薇的版本中，

sentences.en: Alma was awake and alert when the attack commenced.
sentences.zh: 袭击开始时，阿尔玛是清醒且警觉的。

sentences.en: In Sydney's account, Alma was unconscious.
sentences.zh: 在西德尼的陈述中，阿尔玛是昏迷的。

sentences.en: Ivy said Colin had driven back to the city in the early hours, while Sydney claimed he rode a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 艾薇说科林在凌晨开车回到了城里，而西德尼声称他骑的是自行车。

sentences.en: Depending on the witness,
sentences.zh: 根据证人的不同，

sentences.en: Alma's body was either driven or carried to Gun Alley.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的尸体要么是被开车运走的，要么是被抬到冈恩巷的。

sentences.en: The timings of all these happenings conflicted, and when taken as a whole, were completely incoherent.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事件的时间安排都相互冲突，综合来看，完全是不连贯的。

sentences.en: Colin's alleged descriptions of Alma also didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 科林对阿尔玛的所谓描述也对不上号。

sentences.en: Those who knew Alma best said she was a shy and naive girl with a quiet temperament.
sentences.zh: 最了解阿尔玛的人说，她是一个害羞、天真、性格安静的女孩。

sentences.en: Accounts from the so-called Quintet of Disreputals had Colin saying Alma was a cheeky little devil who demanded alcohol, was forthright with men, and sexually active.
sentences.zh: 来自所谓的“五人帮”的陈述称，科林说阿尔玛是一个厚颜无耻的小恶魔，要求喝酒，对男人直言不讳，并且性活跃。

sentences.en: The defence felt there was no way Colin could have interacted with Alma and come away with such an inaccurate character assessment.
sentences.zh: 辩方认为，科林不可能与阿尔玛有过接触，却得出了如此不准确的性格评估。

sentences.en: None of this even took into account the assertions of other witnesses.
sentences.zh: 这些甚至都没有考虑到其他证人的断言。

sentences.en: Sixty other customers visited the Australian Wine Saloon on December 30.
sentences.zh: 12月30日，有60名其他顾客光顾了澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙。

sentences.en: Based on the statements provided by Olive Maddox and Ivy Matthews,
sentences.zh: 根据奥利夫·马多克斯和艾薇·马修斯提供的陈述，

sentences.en: Alma was in the saloon for upwards of three hours that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，阿尔玛在沙龙里待了三个多小时。

sentences.en: Yet, aside from those two women, no one else saw her.
sentences.zh: 然而，除了那两个女人，没有其他人看到她。

sentences.en: Two patrons said they'd shared a drink with Colin Ross and his brother Stanley in the room behind the bar and remained there until closing time.
sentences.zh: 两名顾客说，他们曾和科林·罗斯以及他的兄弟斯坦利在酒吧后面的房间里喝过酒，并一直待到打烊。

sentences.en: They could say with utmost confidence that Alma Tershki was not with them.

sentences.en: George Murphy could have threatened to kill Alma if she exposed his crimes.

sentences.zh: 当乔治得知

sentences.zh: 阿尔玛失踪当天到达肉铺时，并没有表现出焦虑不安。

sentences.en: Therefore,
sentences.zh: 因此，

sentences.zh: 凯文·摩根认为，她的苦难是在离开肉铺后不久开始的。

sentences.en: Witnesses had reported seeing a man following Alma along Little Collins Street before confronting her outside the Eastern Arcade.
sentences.zh: 有目击者称，看到一名男子沿着小柯林斯街跟踪阿尔玛，随后在东方拱廊外拦住了她。

sentences.en: Alma wasn't inclined to speak to strangers, so it was possible that she knew the man.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛不愿与陌生人交谈，所以她有可能认识那个男人。

sentences.en: Alma had been instructed to leave the parcel of meat at her aunt's flat, knowing that the flat itself would be empty.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛曾被嘱咐将那包肉送到她姨妈的公寓，她知道公寓里当时没人。

sentences.en: In a move that was completely out of character for a girl who wrote a school essay titled
sentences.zh: 然而，对于一个曾写过名为

sentences.en: Alma instead slowly and nervously wandered around the neighbouring streets, avoiding her intended destination.
sentences.zh: 的学校作文的女孩来说，她做出了一个完全反常的举动：她缓慢而紧张地在附近的街道上徘徊，避开了原本的目的地。

sentences.zh: 她偏离了前往十分钟路程外姨妈公寓的路线，因为那里已不再是避难所。

sentences.en: Perhaps she was seeking safety by remaining in a public, populated area.
sentences.zh: 也许她留在公共且人多的地方是为了寻求安全。

sentences.en: She wandered into the Eastern Arcade only to realise it wasn't a suitable space for lone children, so she headed back outside.
sentences.zh: 她走进东方拱廊，却意识到那里不适合孤身一人的孩子，于是又回到了外面。

sentences.en: Shortly after this, the screams of a distressed young girl were heard echoing up Little Collins Street.
sentences.zh: 此后不久，小柯林斯街上传来了年轻女孩痛苦的尖叫声。

sentences.zh: 1922年1月，在向媒体发表讲话时，负责特斯基案的调查人员向公众保证，没有任何信息被忽视，每一条所谓的线索都经过了

sentences.en: to the closest scrutiny.

sentences.zh: 当时，该案的首席侦探，

sentences.zh: 弗雷德·皮戈特，被认为是现实生活中的夏洛克·福尔摩斯。

sentences.en: A hard-nosed detective with an eye for detail,
sentences.zh: 作为一名精明强干、目光敏锐的侦探，

sentences.en: Piggott was a celebrity due to his work on many high-profile homicide cases.
sentences.zh: 皮戈特因处理过许多备受瞩目的凶杀案而成为名人。

sentences.en: He was widely regarded as one of the best detectives of his era.
sentences.zh: 他被广泛认为是那个时代最优秀的侦探之一。

sentences.en: His work on the Tursky case not only earned him accolades and respect, but credited him as helping bring forensic science into Australian courtrooMs.
sentences.zh: 他在特斯基案中的工作不仅为他赢得了赞誉和尊重，还被认为有助于将法医学引入澳大利亚法庭。

sentences.en: Detective Piggott had passed away by the time

sentences.zh: 科林·罗斯获得赦免时，皮戈特侦探已经去世了。

sentences.en: During his illustrious career, he was involved in a case involving a husband accused of fatally shooting his wife.
sentences.zh: 在他辉煌的职业生涯中，他曾参与过一起丈夫被控枪杀妻子的案件。

sentences.en: In a groundbreaking move,
sentences.zh: 在一项开创性的举措中，

sentences.zh: 皮戈特进行了维多利亚州刑事案件中首例血迹喷溅分析。

sentences.en: He determined that the killing was in fact a suicide and his work saved the accused from being executed.
sentences.zh: 他断定那起杀人案实际上是自杀，他的工作使被告免于被处决。

sentences.en: What exactly went wrong for Piggott in the Tursky case will never be fully understood.
sentences.zh: 皮戈特在特斯基案中究竟哪里出了错，永远无法完全弄清楚。

sentences.en: He was the type of detective to put in the work to ensure justice was correctly served, but had failed spectacularly in that instance.
sentences.zh: 他本是那种会投入大量工作以确保正义得到伸张的侦探，但在那个案子里却惨败了。

sentences.en: It's believed that Piggott put too much faith in the analysis of the hair evidence, even though it wasn't reliable.
sentences.zh: 人们认为，皮戈特对毛发证据的分析过于信任，尽管这些证据并不可靠。

sentences.en: Still, this didn't answer why so many significant pieces of evidence that exonerated
sentences.zh: 然而，这并不能解释为什么那么多能证明

sentences.en: Colin Ross went willfully ignored.
sentences.zh: 科林·罗斯清白的有力证据被蓄意忽视了。

sentences.en: Detective Piggott gave an interview that touched on the Tursky case, during which he stated,
sentences.zh: 皮戈特侦探在一次采访中谈到了特斯基案，期间他说道：

sentences.en: The public were clamouring for police action and the politicians, of course, were harassing us.
sentences.zh: “公众强烈要求警方采取行动，而政客们当然也在骚扰我们。”

sentences.en: We survived the uproar long enough to plump for the theory that Ross ravished and strangled Alma in the saloon.
sentences.zh: “我们熬过了骚乱，最终选择了罗斯在沙龙里强奸并勒死阿尔玛的理论。”

sentences.en: But we were well aware that our evidence was only circumstantial.
sentences.zh: “但我们很清楚，我们的证据只是间接证据。”

sentences.en: He also said,
sentences.zh: 他还说：

sentences.en: While I suspected Ross, we desired to build up the chain of evidence that was being forged against him.
sentences.zh: “虽然我怀疑罗斯，但我们渴望建立起针对他的证据链。”

sentences.en: In his book on the case,
sentences.zh: 在他关于此案的书中，

sentences.zh: 凯文·摩根对这一断言发表了自己的看法，写道：

sentences.en: Thus, when a piece of evidence could not be forged into a link, it seems it was simply discarded.
sentences.zh: “因此，当某项证据无法被编造成证据链的一环时，它似乎就被直接丢弃了。”

sentences.en: Throughout his time as Colin's attorney,
sentences.zh: 在担任科林律师的整个期间，

sentences.en: Thomas Brennan had received many letters.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·布伦南收到了许多信件。

sentences.en: Some warned him against helping Colin, while others expressed their support of the condemned man.
sentences.zh: 一些信件警告他不要帮助科林，而另一些则表达了对这位死囚的支持。

sentences.en: There were even multiple alleged confessions from someone claiming to be
sentences.zh: 甚至还有多封自称是

sentences.en: Alma Tursky's real killer.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛·特斯基真正凶手的人发来的所谓供词。

sentences.en: Brennan easily recognised the confessions as hoaxes.
sentences.zh: 布伦南很容易就认出这些供词是恶作剧。

sentences.en: Some had been penned by Colin's supporters in the hopes they could somehow prevent his execution.
sentences.zh: 有些是科林的支持者写的，希望能以某种方式阻止他的处决。

sentences.zh: 但在周日，

Colin Ross was set to be executed, an anonymous letter arrived at Brennan's office that he felt was genuine.
sentences.zh: 科林·罗斯被处决的前夕，一封匿名信寄到了布伦南的办公室，他觉得这封信是真实的。

sentences.en: The author left behind no identifying information, save for a postmark indicating the letter had been sent from a country town in Victoria.
sentences.zh: 写信人没有留下任何身份信息，只有一个邮戳，显示这封信是从维多利亚州的一个乡村小镇寄出的。

sentences.en: As reproduced in Brennan's book on the case, titled
sentences.zh: 正如布伦南关于此案的著作《枪巷悲剧》中所转载的那样，

sentences.en: The Gun Alley Tragedy, the letter read to Colin Ross at Melbourne Jail,
sentences.zh: 这封信在墨尔本监狱读给科林·罗斯听，内容如下：

sentences.en: You have been condemned for a crime which you never committed and are to suffer for another's fault.
sentences.zh: “你因一项你从未犯下的罪行而被判刑，并将为他人的过错受罚。”

sentences.en: Since your conviction, you have, no doubt, wondered what manner of man the real murderer is and who could not only encompass the girl's death but allow you to suffer in his stead.
sentences.zh: “自你被定罪以来，你无疑想过真正的凶手是什么样的人，他不仅能掩盖女孩的死亡，还能让你替他受罪。”

sentences.en: My dear Ross, if it is any satisfaction for you to know it, believe me that you will die but once, but he will continue to die for the rest of his life.
sentences.zh: “我亲爱的罗斯，如果知道这一点能让你感到一丝慰藉，请相信我，你只会死一次，但他却将在余生中不断地死去。”

sentences.en: Honoured and formed upon by those who know him, the smile upon his lips but hides the canker eating into his soul.
sentences.zh: “他受到那些认识他的人的尊敬和推崇，但他嘴角的微笑掩盖不了内心正在腐蚀灵魂的毒瘤。”

sentences.en: Day and night, his life is a hell without the hope of reprieve.
sentences.zh: “日日夜夜，他的生活就是一场没有赦免希望的地狱。”

sentences.en: Gladly, would he take your place on Monday next if he had himself alone to consider.
sentences.zh: “如果只需考虑他自己，他会很乐意在下周一代替你去死。”

sentences.en: His reason, then, briefly stated, is this.
sentences.zh: “那么，简而言之，他的理由是这样的。”

sentences.en: A devoted and loving mother is ill.
sentences.zh: “一位慈爱而忠诚的母亲病了。”

sentences.en: A shock would be fatal.
sentences.zh: “任何打击对她来说都是致命的。”

sentences.en: Himself, he will sacrifice when his mother passes away.
sentences.zh: “等他母亲去世后，他会牺牲自己。”

sentences.en: He will do it by his own hand.
sentences.zh: “他会亲手了结自己。”

sentences.en: He will board the ferry across the sticks with a lie on his lips with the only hope that religion is a myth and death annihilation.
sentences.zh: “他将带着谎言踏上通往冥河的渡船，唯一的希望是宗教只是神话，死亡即是湮灭。”

sentences.en: It is too painful for him to go into the details of the crime.
sentences.zh: “对他来说，详述犯罪细节太痛苦了。”

sentences.en: It is simply a Jekyll and Hyde existence.
sentences.zh: “这简直就是杰基尔与海德式的双重生活。”

sentences.en: By a freak of nature, he was not made as other men.
sentences.zh: “由于某种自然界的怪异，他生来就与常人不同。”

sentences.en: This girl was not the firSt.
sentences.zh: “这个女孩并不是第一个。”

sentences.en: With a procurus, all things are possible.
sentences.zh: “有了某种冲动，一切皆有可能。”

sentences.en: In this case, there was no intention of murder.
sentences.zh: “在这种情况下，本无意谋杀。”

sentences.en: The victim unexpectedly collapsed.
sentences.zh: “受害者意外地倒下了。”

sentences.en: May it be some satisfaction to yourself, your devoted mother and the members of your family to know that at least one of the legions of the damned who is the cause of your death
sentences.zh: “愿你能从知道造成你死亡的那些被诅咒的军团中的至少一人正在遭受地狱般的煎熬中，得到一丝慰藉，

sentences.en: is suffering the pangs of hell.
sentences.zh: 他正在承受地狱的折磨。”

sentences.en: He may not ask your forgiveness or sympathy, but he asks for your understanding.
sentences.zh: “他或许不会请求你的宽恕或同情，但他请求你的理解。”
